Job Description
We are looking for an experienced Interim Finance Director to lead our finance
function through a period of rapid growth. You will own the monthly close

on cash flow, budgeting, and forecasting matters across three business units.

Location: London, United Kingdom

Compensation: $700/day
Job type: Contract
Duration: Initial 6 month contract
Start date: Immediate
Skills: Financial Modelling, Stakeholder Management, FP&A, Team Leadership
